name: SleekDB
tagline: Dependency-free PHP library that stores schemaless documents as plain JSON files on disk.
description: SleekDB is a flat-file document store written in pure PHP: each store is a directory, each document a JSON file, and a fluent query builder handles conditions on nested fields, sorting, simple joins between stores, text search and a built-in query result cache. It needs nothing but PHP, which makes it handy on shared hosting, for small CMS-like sites and for prototypes where running MySQL is overkill. The authors themselves aim it at low-to-medium load and a few gigabytes of data; queries scan files and there is no real concurrency control. Version 2.50 (November 2025) moved the library to PHP 8.4.

scale.notes: Designed for a few gigabytes of data and light concurrency.

strengths: Only needs PHP: no server, extension or binary to install
Data stays human-readable JSON files you can inspect, copy and version
Query builder handles nested fields, sorting, joins and text search
Built-in query cache speeds up repeated reads
weaknesses: Queries scan files, so performance falls off as stores grow
No transactions or robust multi-writer locking
PHP-only; other languages cannot share the data safely
Version 2.50 requires PHP 8.4, dropping older hosts
useCases: Small PHP websites on shared hosting
Prototypes and admin tools without a database server
Storing configuration or content as JSON documents
notIdealFor: Multi-language access to the same data
